subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Compression and Power
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Compression and Power.

hook.text: The more you squeeze the fuel-air mix before igniting it, the more energy you extract.

buildup.text: Compression ratio measures how tightly the piston squeezes the mix inside the cylinder.

discovery.text: A ratio of 10:1 means the mix shrinks to one-tenth its volume before the spark fires.

twist.text: Push too high and the fuel ignites on its own before the spark—a destructive event called knock.

climax.text: Engineers balance compression ratio against knock to extract peak power without damage.

punchline.text: Squeezing harder makes power until the engine fights back.
